title: 1975 NORAD report of UFOs over Malmstrom
place_text: Malmstrom Air Force Base missile sites, Montana

tellings.quote: you know, again in, uh, uh, 1975 at Malmstrom. Uh there is a NORAD report of UFO sight settings again over Melmstrom uh missile bases

plain: In 1975, according to a report from NORAD, the joint US and Canadian air defence command, UFOs were seen again over the nuclear missile sites at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana. Robert Salas, a former Air Force missile officer, brings up the report, saying "there is a NORAD report of UFO sightings again over Malmstrom missile bases," as proof that strange objects kept coming back to the nuclear weapons.
